value.rationale: The first natural omitted odd-coefficient case (1,9) in the historical dyadic Lucas-stability classification admits a distinctive 2-adic critical point. Exact frequency 2^(floor(k/2)) of a canonically defined residue for all k>=5 proves genuinely unbounded occurrence multiplicities and hence nonstability, substantially beyond a finite computation or trivial congruence.
